runtime: Power Automate/SharePoint only; Python is isolated local reference/test tooling
coordination: One per-group conditional owner token used by ALL capacity/state/membership-changing writers, plus stable saved operation receipt. No lease expiry, takeover timer, child flow or background repair platform.

keys.OperationKey: kind:trusted-actor-id:intent-uuid; one intent ID reused across transport retries; immutable intent bound to receipt.
keys.SendOperationKey: Unique immutable operation key on request; protects delayed/unknown create retries.
keys.ConnectionKey: Unique nonblank open:person:min:max or open:group:groupId:participant:id while Pending or Accepted-incomplete; rekey history:request:id only on settled completion/decline/cancel.
keys.SourceRequestId: Unique group source request ID; existing accepted target, verify before use.
keys.EventKey: Unique request:id:terminal:status fact after committed operation; not exactly-once external delivery guarantee.

proposedMetadataNotApplied.OperationReceipts: Unique required OperationKey, immutable IntentJson, result/reference JSON, completion/uncertain/retry-stage metadata. One bounded receipt per intent, not a transaction service.
proposedMetadataNotApplied.Groups: WriteOwner: operation + attempt token; exact ETag claim/release; no automatic expiration.
proposedMetadataNotApplied.Requests: Unique SendOperationKey/ConnectionKey, WinningOperationKey, OperationComplete. Existing Status retains Pending/Accepted/Declined/Cancelled vocabulary.
proposedMetadataNotApplied.ExistingGroupMemberKeys: Verify Groups.SourceRequestId and GroupMembers.MembershipKey unique/indexed and actual mapping under #12; do not enable constraints blindly on existing rows.

productionIntentComparison: Use native equals(json(stored IntentJson), canonical typed intent object); model SHA fingerprint is local convenience, not a required hashing connector or authorization proof.
commit: Only changed row CAS, automatic retries disabled; verify exact receipt/group/parties/membership result. Accepted-incomplete not success. Provisional Active rows count toward capacity but not operational membership until committed request/complete group.

recovery.normal: Replay saved completed result. At a stopped definite-error boundary with reconciled stable prefix and no outstanding I/O, seal old attempt and persist Retryable before releasing; a fresh bounded user retry reuses keys. Max three sealed attempts before exceptional support.
recovery.uncertain: Do not seal/release/steal based on elapsed time or missing row. Reconcile expected unique-key writes/readbacks first; otherwise explicit rare support. No false success or universal automatic-repair promise.
recovery.completedRelease: If receipt complete but release failed, exact old-token release may be finalized without repeating domain writes. Sealed/complete attempts cannot resume domain mutations.

writers.10: Send idempotency + pending-connection keys; trusted actor/current validity from own adapter.
writers.11: Pending decision CAS, initial group SourceRequestId unique, guard/episode writes/commit readback.
writers.13: Same group guard for capacity/state updates; never below counted Active/provisional rows; Ended final.
writers.14: Same group guard; conditional Active -> Left episode, preserve Closed and history; no auto rejoin.
writers.17: Send group-join keys and duplicate connection guard; no membership creation at Send.
writers.63: Pending-only cancel CAS conflicts with accept; cannot reverse Accepted-incomplete.
writers.65: Same group guard + current rereads + terminal request CAS; one admitted slot, shared with #11/#13/#14.

assumptions: All writers obey same group guard
